integrity.reproducibility: standalone check.py verified finite cases with NumPy and SciPy

scientific_limitations: Exact graph family is finite unweighted balanced double stars only; the heat generator is the unnormalized combinatorial Laplacian.
The peak asymptotic is for the degree tending to infinity and is not a uniform-in-time approximation.
Historical literature coverage remains incomplete, and an equivalent prior computation cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp transient Lipschitz amplification on balanced double-star trees
